decisions.reason: Naval lighting remains a strategic specialist niche with long procurement and approval cycles, so the option value of waiting still outweighs the limited carrying cost.
After two years a spring-balanced desk lamp remains peripheral to the firm's project-led core and in a crowded category, so we would redeploy resources rather than keep this option open.
This general interior luminaire fits the core portfolio and, absent clear failure, continuing it preserves learning and cross-selling value at low incremental risk.
As a flagship pendant aligned with the firm's strategic move toward high-quality application-specific LED solutions, it should be retained unless performance turns clearly adverse.
The marine searchlight line still fits the firm's specialist transport lighting capabilities and likely faces slower niche demand realization, making continued observation preferable to early exit.
